newsitem.title: UK: BA says no decision on cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: BA says no decision on cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: British Airways Plc World Cargo has taken no decision on whether or not to lift the cargo fuel surcharge introduced on November 8, a spokesman said.
He was commenting on the decision earlier today Delta Air Lines Inc to drop with immediate effect the cargo fuel surcharge of US 10 cents per kg introduced on November 8 last year.
BA Cargo applied a six pence per kg fuel surcharge on intercontinental freight with three pence per kg on European and UK routes following the steep increase in jet fuel prices during 1996.
